query: SELECT Id, Name, SBQQ__Active__c, SBQQ__Type__c, SBQQ__Scope__c, SBQQ__EvaluationEvent__c, SBQQ__EvaluationOrder__c, SBQQ__ConditionsMet__c, SBQQ__AdvancedCondition__c, SBQQ__ErrorMessage__c, LastModifiedDate FROM SBQQ__ProductRule__c WHERE Name = 'Region India Selection Rule (Demo)'

SELECT Id, Name, SBQQ__Index__c, SBQQ__TestedObject__c, SBQQ__TestedField__c, SBQQ__TestedVariable__c, SBQQ__TestedVariable__r.Name, SBQQ__TestedAttribute__c, SBQQ__Operator__c, SBQQ__FilterType__c, SBQQ__FilterValue__c, SBQQ__FilterVariable__c, SBQQ__FilterVariable__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM SBQQ__ErrorCondition__c WHERE SBQQ__Rule__c = 'a0pg8000003CHbFAAW' ORDER BY SBQQ__Index__c

SELECT Id, Name, SBQQ__Type__c, SBQQ__Product__c, SBQQ__Product__r.Name, SBQQ__Product__r.ProductCode, SBQQ__Product__r.IsActive, SBQQ__Required__c, SBQQ__FilterField__c, SBQQ__Operator__c, SBQQ__FilterValue__c, SBQQ__ValueObject__c, SBQQ__ValueField__c, SBQQ__ParentRuleIsActive__c, LastModifiedDate FROM SBQQ__ProductAction__c WHERE SBQQ__Rule__c = 'a0pg8000003CHbFAAW' ORDER BY Name

SELECT Id, Name, SBQQ__Active__c, SBQQ__Product__c, SBQQ__Product__r.Name, SBQQ__Product__r.IsActive, SBQQ__ProductFeature__c, SBQQ__ProductFeature__r.Name, SBQQ__ProductFeature__r.SBQQ__OptionSelectionMethod__c, SBQQ__ProductFeature__r.SBQQ__ConfiguredSKU__c, SBQQ__RuleType__c, SBQQ__RuleEvaluationEvent__c, LastModifiedDate FROM SBQQ__ConfigurationRule__c WHERE SBQQ__ProductRule__c = 'a0pg8000003CHbFAAW' ORDER BY Name
SELECT Id, Name, IsActive, LastModifiedDate FROM Product2 WHERE Name = 'Process Instrumentation Pack (Demo)'
